entries.title: Genesis 6:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born to them,

entries.title: Genesis 6:2
segments: that the sons of God saw the daughters of men, that they [were] beautiful; and they took wives for themselves of all whom they chose.

entries.title: Genesis 6:3
segments: ¶And the LORD said, "My Spirit shall not strive with man forever, for he [is] indeed flesh; yet his days shall be one hundred and twenty years."

entries.title: Genesis 6:4
segments: ¶There were giants on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men and they bore [children] to them. Those [were] the mighty men who [were] of old, men of renown.

entries.title: Genesis 6:5
segments: Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man [was] great in the earth, and [that] every intent of the thoughts of his heart [was] only evil continually.

entries.title: Genesis 6:6
segments: ¶And the LORD was sorry that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.

entries.title: Genesis 6:7
segments: So the LORD said, "I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth, both man and beast, creeping thing and birds of the air, for I am sorry that I have made them."

entries.title: Genesis 6:8
segments: ¶But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 6:9
segments: This is the genealogy of Noah. Noah was a just man, perfect in his generations. Noah walked with God.

entries.title: Genesis 6:10
segments: And Noah begot three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

entries.title: Genesis 6:11
segments: ¶The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

entries.title: Genesis 6:12
segments: So God looked upon the earth, and indeed it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 6:13
segments: ¶And God said to Noah, "The end of all flesh has come before Me, for the earth is filled with violence through them; and behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 6:14
segments: "Make yourself an ark of gopherwood; make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and outside with pitch.

entries.title: Genesis 6:15
segments: "And this is how you shall make it: The length of the ark [shall be] three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

entries.title: Genesis 6:16
segments: "You shall make a window for the ark, and you shall finish it to a cubit from above; and set the door of the ark in its side. You shall make it [with] lower, second, and third [decks].

entries.title: Genesis 6:17
segments: "And behold, I Myself am bringing floodwaters on the earth, to destroy from under heaven all flesh in which [is] the breath of life; everything that [is] on the earth shall die.

entries.title: Genesis 6:18
segments: "But I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall go into the ark-you, your sons, your wife, and your sons' wives with you.

entries.title: Genesis 6:19
segments: "And of every living thing of all flesh you shall bring two of every [sort] into the ark, to keep [them] alive with you; they shall be male and female.

entries.title: Genesis 6:20
segments: "Of the birds after their kind, of animals after their kind, and of every creeping thing of the earth after its kind, two of every [kind] will come to you to keep [them] alive.

entries.title: Genesis 6:21
segments: "And you shall take for yourself of all food that is eaten, and you shall gather [it] to yourself; and it shall be food for you and for them."

entries.title: Genesis 6:22
segments: ¶Thus Noah did; according to all that God commanded him, so he did.
